text: One for the day. One for the night.
The Quran tells us the moon was made a light...
The sun runs on, to a resting place of its own.
The moon is given its stations, until it returns, thin and curved, like an old palm stalk.
Each swims in its own orbit.
Every sunrise, on time. Every new moon, on time.
The Quran says they move by precise measure.
And of His signs are the night and the day, the sun and the moon.
Do not bow to the sun, nor to the moon...
but to the One who created them.
